title: Patrick Kearon
vital_facts: Baptiazed 1987, Ordination to Priesthood followed shortly
Concluded formal education in his late teens, having attended schools in Saudi Arabia and England.
Married Jennifer Carole Hulme, 1991, Oakland California Temple; Four children
Until his recent call to the Seventy, owner with his wife of Kearon Hulme Communications, a public affairs consultancy.
Ward Young Men President; Counselor in Bishopric; Branch President; Stake President; Area Seventy serving in Europe Area presidency.
